messages:
maria: Quick check — trying to onboard robin-13b-quant into the model catalog. We uploaded weights to s3://rw-models/robin/13b/v1-quant.tar but preflight errors out on tokenizer mismatch. Anyone seen this?

alex: Which tokenizer artifact did you point to in the catalog entry? There are two variants (tokenizer-v1 and tokenizer-v1-legacy).

maria: catalog entry points to s3://rw-models/robin/13b/tokenizer-v1/ (vocab.json, merges.txt). Error snippet: 
```
ValueError: BOS token id mismatch: model expects 1, tokenizer has 0
 at tokenizer.load_tokenizer
```

ben: That usually means the vocab/special_tokens.json were generated with a different special tokens mapping. Run our checker: `infra/tools/tokenizer_check.py --vocab path --expected-bos 1`

priya: Also noticed model_config.json has `max_seq_len: 2048` but our serving defaults to 4096. Compiler stage rejects it when route profile isn't set. Add `max_input_length: 2048` to the catalog entry or update the serving profile.

sam: For the rollout plan: canary in us-east-1 only, 2 pods pinned to robin-13b-quant:v1. Fallback_variant = robin-7b-quant (robin-lite). Want to allow automatic fallback on OOM and kernel errors. Thoughts?

maria: Yep. Add `fallback_variant: robin-7b-quant` and `fallback_on: [OOM, KERNEL_ERROR]` in the catalog. Also we should pin the exact artifact checksum so we don't accidentally pick up a new tokenizer.

alex: I'll add `tokenizer_checksum` to the catalog schema (small CR incoming). @maria please include the checksum in the PR.

deploy-bot: pipeline triggered: catalog/update robin-13b-quant:v1 -> validate -> preflight tests. Job #4421.

ben: Perf note: on an A40 with 13b-quant + KV cache warm, steady-state is ~45ms/token single-threaded. For p99 latency target <=200ms, suggest `max_batch: 8` and `max_concurrent_requests: 12`. Adding to rollout doc.

priya: I'll run config validation and the tokenizer check after you push the checksum. I have a small test harness for special token mappings that catches the BOS/EOF mismatch.

sam: Region enablement: infra says EU capacity is available but legal flagged data residency for hosted in eu-west-1. For hosted API we need EU-data addendum signoff; for Dedicated/private it's fine. @infra-bot confirm capacity?

infra-bot: eu-west-1 capacity report: GPUs available: 12, reserved: 4, estimated headroom for canaries: 8. No infra blockers.

maria: Great — I'll update the catalog entry with tokenizer_checksum and max_input_length, push the PR, and mark the canary start in the PR description. Priya — after we merge can you run evals/regression checks on the tagged prompts?

priya: Yep, will run regen and check quality deltas, will post results here.

alex: CR link posted: https://git.company/repo/pull/782 — small schema bump plus docs update. @maria a quick nudge when ready.

maria: Thanks all, pushing fixes now. Will kick off canary once deploy-bot reports green. :thumbsup:
